name: Facet
text:
DO: Default to a single high-contrast dark theme with a persistent, one-click toggle to light mode.

A high-contrast dark theme sharpens visibility and reduces eye strain during long sessions, matching our goal of liveliness and clarity. The one-click toggle respects user preference without cluttering the interface, accepting the trade-off of slightly slower load times for the toggle’s assets. This keeps the design clean and consistent while giving users control, aligning with our quality-first approach.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A single high-contrast dark theme still locks out users who need light mode for accessibility or context—like editing screenshots or working in bright rooms. A persistent toggle risks inconsistency: users won’t reliably switch, and the interface will fragment into two half-baked modes. Settle it with user testing: measure task completion and comfort in both themes across roles.

name: Facet
text:
DO: Default to a dark theme but auto-switch to light mode when the system’s light mode is detected.

This keeps high-contrast visibility as the default while respecting accessibility needs without manual effort. The trade-off is a slight inconsistency in the interface’s appearance, but it ensures users get the best of both worlds automatically.

name: Pane
text: Pane: Auto-switching still fragments the interface—users see two modes, not one, and the transition creates jarring inconsistency. Better: default to a single high-contrast dark theme with a *persistent* light mode toggle, but enforce a *system-wide* light/dark setting that overrides EXCAVA’s default. Settle when the lead confirms this hybrid approach and the toggle’s behavior is documented in the interface spec.

name: Lumen
text:
DECISION: Default to a single high-contrast dark theme with a persistent, one-click toggle to light mode, but enforce system-wide light/dark settings to override EXCAVA’s default.

Result: A unified interface that prioritizes visibility and accessibility without fragmentation. Owned by Facet (visualization-w1).
